title: My 5 Favorite AI Tools in 2026
channel: Chris Koerner on The Koerner Office Podcast

idea.name: AI-accelerated business mediation service
idea.one_liner: Mediator uses a ChatGPT prompting system where both parties submit their side, saving an hour per mediation so they can take on 20 more clients a month

key_quotes.quote: The trick is I would like to start using figuring out a way to use this for mediation in business disputes.
But I do think if you're a mediator and your business is mediation for those types of businesses, your bottleneck is you.

claims.claim: Save an hour per mediation, 20 more clients/month
claims.quote: If you could use chat tpt to build a rapper or to build a prompting system to get that information quicker so that you save an hour per mediation

ideas.other_uk_rules: UK GDPR when uploading dispute data to third-party AI

idea.name: Pay-to-certify 'voted best' rating agency
idea.one_liner: Marketplace where local businesses pay ~$200 to be certified 'best' and receive a window sign, inspired by a 'voted best dentist' sign that won a customer for 8 years

key_quotes.quote: So, his idea was like there needs to be some sort of like a marketplace where you could get like certified by whoever.
It doesn't matter. You pay 200 bucks, you get a sign.

ideas.other_uk_rules: DMCC Act/CPRs: unsubstantiated 'voted best' claims and paid endorsements can be misleading commercial practices
